title: New Traffic Fines Imposed on Lahore Ring Road
excerpt: Authorities significantly increase traffic fines on Lahore Ring Road to strictly enforce road safety rules and crack down on violations.
body_html:
Authorities have significantly increased traffic fines along the Lahore Ring Road. This move is part of an effort to step up enforcement against various road safety violations in the area.

The updated enforcement specifically targets severe infractions, including driving without a valid license and underage driving. Officials are implementing these higher penalties in an effort to improve overall traffic compliance and safety on the major roadway.
